summary: Fresh starts: a worker writes a where-I-am note (rollcall task where), and once the ship script holds its PR, or after an hour parked at a large context, a fresh worker starts from that note instead of resuming the old conversation. New /handoff skill for handing off and resuming by hand.
why: Resuming a long conversation re-reads its whole context on every turn; a fresh worker with the note costs a fraction of that.
